notes.title: Parallel: Ghost in the Pool Remastered Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that Weird Tales Studio: Ghost in the Pool has received a major remastered update!

This is the most significant content and system upgrade since the game's release in 2021. The main features of this update include:

[h2]🔧 Feature Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rebuilt the underlying framework to improve stability and fix multiple bugs
[*] Optimized UI experience with support for progress branch jumping, resulting in smoother overall operation
[/list]

Fully optimized the save system to enhance compatibility and security

[h2]📝 Story Expansion[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significantly expanded the original storyline, filling in key clues
[*] Added more side quests and multiple ending branches to enhance playability and exploration
[*] Improved character motivations, enriching the protagonist Wang Yaru's psychological transformation and growth
[/list]

[h2]🏆 Achievement System Online[/h2]
Added 19 new Steam achievements for players to unlock and challenge

💡This update is free of charge, and all players who have purchased the game can directly update and experience it.

Thank you to all the players who have supported us. We will continue to work hard to improve the series and tell more stories of Eastern horror.

——CASCHA GAMES

notes.title: Ghost in the pool Final version is out!
notes.notes:
After 3 months of iteration, the final version of the Ghost in the pool is finally out.

Me and Joey trying our best to improve the experiences of the game, and hopefully, it is better than the early access version. :P

[h3]So, what are the differences in the final version compared to the early access version:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the sound balancing between the music and the SFX
[*] add more new sound effects to increase the mood
[*] adding 3 brand new stories cutscenes into the main story
[*] adding 100+ new interaction with more peace of information around the story and the characters
[*] Brand new save path system to get rid of the old save slot system, so after you finish one line of the main story you can easily switching the restarting point anywhere on the timeline.
[*] improved the text speed and the auto dialog waiting logic
[*] rework the 4 nightmares with more interesting visual and interactions
[*] 6 languages fully support (English, Spanish, Turkish, Korean, Japanese, Chinese)
[*] New "诡闻斋“ introduction page
[/list]

Thank you so much for supporting us in the game!
